endpoints.title: Elasticsearch endpoints
endpoints.description: List of Elasticsearch/OpenSearch node URLs (e.g. http://localhost:9200). Server certificates are NOT verified on https endpoints.

index.title: Index name
index.description: Base index name. Must be lowercase, start with a letter or digit, and contain only letters, digits, and the characters _ . + and -. Audits are written to dated indices below it and searched across <index>-*. Domains sharing an index name share retention, deletion and blast radius; give a domain its own name to isolate them.

rolloverPeriod.title: Index rollover period
rolloverPeriod.description: How often a new index is started: daily (<index>-yyyy.MM.dd), weekly (<index>-yyyy.wWW) or monthly (<index>-yyyy.MM), all in UTC. Shard count follows your retention window, so weekly cuts it roughly sevenfold and monthly roughly thirtyfold. Longer periods make date filtering prune fewer shards. Changing this leaves existing indices readable.

username.title: Authentication user
username.description: User used to authenticate against Elasticsearch (basic authentication).

password.title: Authentication password
password.description: Password used to authenticate against Elasticsearch.

sslKeystoreType.title: Client certificate type
sslKeystoreType.description: Type of client certificate presented to Elasticsearch (jks, pkcs12 or pem). Leave empty when no client certificate is required. This does not enable server certificate verification.

sslKeystorePath.title: Client keystore path
sslKeystorePath.description: Path to the JKS or PKCS12 keystore. Not used when the type is pem.

sslKeystorePassword.title: Client keystore password
sslKeystorePassword.description: Password of the JKS or PKCS12 keystore.

sslPemCerts.title: Client PEM certificates
sslPemCerts.description: Paths to the PEM certificate files. Used when the client certificate type is pem.

sslPemKeys.title: Client PEM keys
sslPemKeys.description: Paths to the PEM private key files. Used when the client certificate type is pem.

bulkActions.title: Bulk actions
bulkActions.description: Number of documents buffered before a bulk flush.

flushInterval.title: Bulk flush interval
flushInterval.description: Flush interval for bulk actions, in seconds.

maxPendingBatches.title: Maximum pending batches
maxPendingBatches.description: Upper bound on bulk batches held in memory while Elasticsearch is slow or unreachable. Beyond it the oldest pending batch is dropped and counted.

maxConcurrentRequests.title: Maximum concurrent requests
maxConcurrentRequests.description: Upper bound on bulk requests in flight at once.

retryAttempts.title: Retry attempts
retryAttempts.description: How many times a failed batch is retried before it is dropped and counted.

retryInitialInterval.title: Initial retry interval
retryInitialInterval.description: First retry delay in seconds. Doubles per attempt up to the maximum retry interval.

retryMaxInterval.title: Maximum retry interval
retryMaxInterval.description: Ceiling on the retry delay, in seconds.

shutdownFlushTimeout.title: Shutdown flush timeout
shutdownFlushTimeout.description: How long a stopping reporter waits for buffered audits to be acknowledged, in seconds.
